dict.string: Find files and folders and open with {query}
Find files and folders and open with {query}
選択したフォルダをアプリで開く

on alfred_script(q) set finderSelection to "" set theTarget to "" set appName to q set appPath to path to application appName set defaultTarget to (path to home folder as alias) tell application "System Events" set selectApp to name of the first process whose frontmost is true end tell -- comment line above and uncomment line below to open desktop instead of user home when there's no selection or open folder in the Finder: -- set defaultTarget to (path to desktop folder as alias) if selectApp is "Finder" then tell application "Finder" set finderSelection to (get selection) if length of finderSelection is greater than 0 then set theTarget to finderSelection else try set theTarget to POSIX path of the target of the front finder window on error set theTarget to defaultTarget end try end if tell application "Finder" open theTarget using appPath end tell end tell else tell application "Path Finder" set theTarget to {} repeat with pfItem in (get selection) set the end of theTarget to POSIX path of pfItem end repeat end tell tell application appName open theTarget end tell end if end alfred_script

#!/usr/bin/env zsh
query="$1" # 使わないが残しておく
# 検索対象フォルダ folders=( "/Applications" "/Users/${USER}/Applications" )
# キャッシュ関連 cache_dir="${alfred_workflow_cache:-/tmp}" cache_file="${cache_dir}/apps_list.txt" cache_ttl=604800 # 1週間 mkdir -p "$cache_dir"
# キャッシュ更新チェック need_update_cache=0 if [[ ! -f "$cache_file" ]]; then need_update_cache=1 else now_epoch=$(date +%s) mtime_epoch=$(stat -f %m "$cache_file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) (( now_epoch - mtime_epoch > cache_ttl )) && need_update_cache=1 fi
# キャッシュ更新：find するのはここだけ if (( need_update_cache )); then : > "$cache_file" for f in "${folders[@]}"; do if [[ -d "$f" ]]; then find "$f" -maxdepth 2 -type d -name "*.app" >> "$cache_file" fi done fi
# キャッシュから読み込んでそのまま全部返す（←重要） items=() while IFS= read -r app; do [[ -z "$app" ]] && continue
name="${app##*/}" name="${name%.app}"
# ここではフィルタしない（Alfred に任せる） items+=( "$(printf '{"title":"%s","subtitle":"%s","arg":"%s","icon":{"type":"fileicon","path":"%s"}}' \ "$name" "$app" "$app" "$app")" ) done < "$cache_file"
printf '{ "items": [ %s ] }' "$(IFS=,; echo "${items[*]}")"
選択したアプリケーションでフォルダを開く

on run argv set finderSelection to "" set theTarget to "" set appName to (system attribute "application") set appPath to path to application appName set defaultTarget to (path to home folder as alias) tell application "System Events" set selectApp to name of the first process whose frontmost is true end tell set targets to {} set oldDelimiters to text item delimiters set text item delimiters to tab set qArray to every text item of argv set text item delimiters to oldDelimiters repeat with atarget in qArray if atarget starts with "~" then set userHome to POSIX path of (path to home folder) if userHome ends with "/" then set userHome to characters 1 thru -2 of userHome as string end if try set atarget to userHome & characters 2 thru -1 of atarget as string on error set atarget to userHome end try end if set targetAlias to ((POSIX file atarget) as alias) set targets to targets & targetAlias end repeat set theTarget to targets tell application "Finder" open theTarget using appPath end tell end run

キーワードの後にアプリケーション名を入れると、現在Finderで選択しているファイル・フォルダを開けます（Path Finderにも対応）。
[ol]キーワードの場合は、選択するアプリケーションをあらかじめ「List Filter」に登録したアプリケーションの中から検索して実行できます。 「List Filter」に追加する場合は「Arg」の値が正式なアプリケーション名になっている必要があります。
